bullets.text: Building Trusted Communities - **Microsoft** supports game developers with enhanced security features in **Windows 11**.
Windows 11 Update Released - **Microsoft** rolls out Build 22631.6269 to the Release Preview Channel with quality improvements.
Planet-Scale AI Superfactory - **Microsoft** unveils a new **Azure AI** datacenter design to meet unprecedented AI compute demand.
Transforming Business with AI - **Frontier firms** leverage **Microsoft AI** for significant business impact and industry leadership.
Call of Duty Launch Details - **Microsoft** announces **Call of Duty: Black Ops 7** will be available on Game Pass from day one.
Advancing Security Initiatives - **Microsoft**'s Secure Future Initiative reports progress in enhancing security across platforms.
